Example weather dataset for miniSTICS

weather_example.Rd

A daily weather dataset used to demonstrate and test the miniSTICS crop model. This dataset can be used in examples, vignettes, and unit tests to illustrate model usage.

Usage

weather_example

Format

A data frame with 11 variables and one row per day:

Date

Date of observation (Date class or character convertible to Date)

ANNEE

Year of observation

DOY

Day of year (1–365/366)

Temp_min

Minimum air temperature (°C)

Temp_moy

Mean air temperature (°C)

Temp_max

Maximum air temperature (°C)

Radiation

Incoming global solar radiation (MJ m-2 day-1)

Rain

Precipitation (mm)

Wind

Wind speed (m s-1)

Rel_Hum

Relative humidity (%)

Photoperiod

Day length (hours)

Source

Converted from MiniSTICS_weather.csv using package data preparation workflow.

Details

The dataset was derived from a CSV file (MiniSTICS_weather.csv) and formatted for inclusion in the package using usethis::use_data().

This dataset is intended for testing and demonstration purposes only. It does not represent measured observational data and may be partially simulated or adapted from external sources.
